description: This file contains the core business logic for event management in a microservice architecture. It defines the EventService class, which provides methods to create, configure, and retrieve events, integrating with data repositories, transformers, validators, and logging. Placeholder methods for Kafka messaging are also included.

classes.name: EventService
classes.description: Handles business rules for event management, including creating, configuring, and retrieving events, with logging, validation, transformation, and placeholder Kafka integration.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_event(self, event_data: dict)
methods.description: Validates and creates a new event, transforming data and storing it in the repository, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] configure_event(self, config_data: dict)
methods.description: Updates the configuration of an existing event, including validation, existence check, and logging.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_event(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves event data by ID, transforming from persistence format, with error handling.

methods.description: Placeholder method for publishing an 'event configured' message to Kafka.
